name: 1541HUD Fire-24G Control - lower C000 socket
description: ROM-free CLI template for a standard two-page lower-socket Control installation. No RAMBoard is assumed.

roms.label: PRIVATE ROM SET
roms.description: Lower C000-DFFF page supplied by owner
Upper E000-FFFF page supplied by owner

notes: Standard lower-socket layout: roms[0] is C000-DFFF and roms[1] is the X1-fed E000-FFFF page. Both input files must be 8192 bytes. No RAMBoard or A-page wiring is required. Duplicate the final ROM set locally for additional lawful DOS profiles.
